files.description: Repository conventions: package layout and decoupling rule, zero-dependency policy, build/test/lint commands, conventions for errors/tests/docs, documentation-site workflow.
The *errors.Error type (Code, Message, Fields, Details, Stack) and its constructors that router and response render into HTTP output.
Package overview for the SQL builder: dialects, placeholder handling, and supported query shapes.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI (note revive's 'exported' check is disabled here); avoid duplicating what golangci-lint already flags.
Keep-a-Changelog history — check for a 'Fixed' entry describing the exact bug class a change might be reintroducing (e.g. the sqlbuilder set-op rework, the router error-Details fix).
The Document type: Add/Sync mutate d.paths and must invalidate the rendered-JSON cache (d.cache); JSON()/Handler() render and cache the OpenAPI 3.1 document from it.

otel's shared config/options, including defaultSpanName (the source of truth for naming spans/metrics from a request's matched route pattern) and the OpenTelemetry globals (TracerProvider, MeterProvider, propagator) Middleware/Transport/WrapCheck default to.
The otel submodule's own Keep-a-Changelog history — it's versioned independently from the core module (tagged otel/vX.Y.Z), so check here rather than the root CHANGELOG.md for prior otel/ fixes.
